title: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py: Standalone select_channel has same out-of-bounds bug
description:
The standalone select_channel function at line 199 duplicates the same flawed logic: `n = max(plan.num_channels - 1, 2)` followed by `return 1 + (h % n)`. Same out-of-bounds behavior for plans with 1-2 channels.

Fix suggestion: Apply the same fix as line 57, or refactor to call the method version to avoid code duplication.
close_reason: Duplicate of project-LICHEN-worker6-61ja, fixed in same commit.
